Name: On The Line
Author: Xvordan
Description:
1. Regenerate a configurable amount of stamina when you get a perfect catch.

2. Take a snapshot of any buffs that modify your fishing skill at the start of the fishing minigame. When you achieve a perfect catch, restore the buff to that snapshot. This only works if the buff didn't wear out during the minigame.

3. Play a gentle audible queue on a perfect catch.

4. Display the name of the fish on the line, so you don't have to waste a tackle slot on the sonar bobber.

5. Display the fishing zone where your bobber lands.

6. While wielding a fishing rod, right click a valid water tile to see its fishing zone and possible catches during the current conditions.

7. Temporary Blacklist (while wielding a fishing rod): Press Shift while right clicking on a valid tile to be able to select fish to be blacklisted. While AutoBlacklist is on, any fish you abort during the fishing minigame is blacklisted. Press Z or the middle mouse button to remove fish from the blacklist. Right click any nonfishable tile to clear the blacklist. The blacklist is also cleared if you switch away from your fishing rod or go to sleep.

8. The Blacklist Consumes Stamina can be turned off. Doing so will restore the stamina you spent to cast the line before the mod aborts a fish -- blacklisted fish become free casts.

9. If you're using magnet bait and a treasure hunter, automatically prime treasure chests to be caught.

10. Tackle that's undamaged will stack. Damage tackle will not.

11. Auto replace worn out tackle on your rod. The mod will prefer your damaged tackle, and will only place the same tackle type on your rod.

12. Every time you catch anything that isn't categorized as a fish, you have a 1% chance to generate a fishing bubble where your bobber landed. Bait increases the chance by another 1%, and each bobber on your rod adds another 1%.

All settings are configurable.

Manifest.Name: On The Line
Manifest.Description: Rewards perfect catches with stamina restoration, announces the fishing zone and fish on the line, auto-catches treasure with the right gear, and can report catchable fish at a tile on demand.
